Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) is the commuter train service in the San Francisco Bay Area. Commuters
use BART trains and can transfer at various stations to Caltrain lines to reach extended destinations not
accessible by BART. BART riders who transfer at the Millbrae station must wait between 9 and 16 minutes
for their connecting train according to BART statistics. Due to scheduling, the wait time for the connection
follows a uniform distribution. Graph the probability density function for
